text:
Type: capsule-shaped white wall lamp
Use: soft accent or bedside light on a wall; bedroom, hallway, bathroom, living room
Style: minimalist, modern, Scandinavian
Materials: white lacquered metal top, white opal glass lower half, white round wall plate
Colors: white, milky white
Shape: vertical pill shape with rounded ends held out from a round wall disc on a short stem, smooth and seamless, compact and light
Feel: clean, soft, calm, sleek
Goes with: white or pale grey walls, light wood, chrome or white fittings; minimalist or Scandinavian rooms

product.name: STAN
product.description: Provides an even light that is good for illuminating around a mirror and sink.
